children: Senegal’s annual inflation rate slowed to 1.0% in September 2026 from August’s three-month high of 1.2%.

The deceleration came as food and beverages inflation, the largest component of the inflation basket, eased to 0.9% from a four-month high of 1.4% in August. Inflation also moderated for transport (1.2% vs 1.7% in August), alcoholic beverages and tobacco (12.0% vs 12.6%), restaurants and hotels (1.8% vs 2.2%), and financial services (1.0% vs 1.1%).
Meanwhile, inflation remained steady for recreation, sports and culture (at 0.8%), education (at 1.0%), and clothing and footwear (at 1.1%).
By contrast, furnishings inflation accelerated slightly (0.7% vs 0.6%), while housing and utilities rebounded (0.1% vs -0.9%).
On a monthly basis, consumer prices rose 1.1%, slowing from a 2.0% gain in the prior month, which was the highest level since July 2023.

title: Senegal Inflation Rate Eases to 1% in September
